title: Viral Generator Framework — Framework Overview
description: The whole framework: components, pipeline, and how tools assemble from parts.
body: The Signature edition record for the framework component: Framework Overview. The whole framework: components, pipeline, and how tools assemble from parts. This is the overview record of the reusable viral generator framework, the strongest direction named in the catalog: instead of programming every viral tool from scratch, new tools assemble from common components. The framework provides seven components. The prompt processor normalizes prompts, extracts keywords, and detects intent. The data retriever fetches matching templates deterministically by seed. The generation core combines the processed prompt with retrieved material into a concept with a title, hook, beats, and call to action. The renderer turns concepts into markdown, HTML, or plain-text share cards. The validator checks every concept against its schema. The personalizer applies style and audience preferences supplied at runtime and stores nothing. The exporter packages everything with attribution. The overview demo runs the entire pipeline end to end on a sample prompt and reports each stage, so the framework is exercised, not just described. Reference implementation: every component is real working JavaScript, executed and tested in node. A specification alone does not perform media rendering — video, audio, or photoreal image output still requires a real model or connected rendering engine wired to the renderer interface. Runtime status is tested: the code runs in node and every demo output stored here was produced by executing it.

title: Viral Generator Framework — Prompt Processor
description: Normalizes prompts, extracts keywords, and detects intent.
body: The Signature edition record for the framework component: Prompt Processor. Normalizes prompts, extracts keywords, and detects intent. The prompt processor takes a raw user prompt and returns a structured request: the original text, normalized tokens, keywords, detected intents, and a word count. Intent detection is heuristic and honest about it: keyword patterns map to video-concept, meme, challenge, story, music, visual, or general-concept. Prompts are trimmed and length-bounded, punctuation is normalized, and empty input yields a clean general-concept request rather than an error. The demo processes a sample prompt and returns its tokens, keywords, and intents as data.

title: Viral Generator Framework — Data Retriever
description: Deterministic template retrieval by seed and intent.
body: The Signature edition record for the framework component: Data Retriever. Deterministic template retrieval by seed and intent. The data retriever matches a processed prompt against an embedded template bank using a deterministic hash of the keywords and the seed. Same keywords and same seed always return the same templates, which makes retrieval reproducible and testable. Templates are matched by intent first, falling back to the whole bank for general requests. Three templates are returned per query: enough to combine, few enough to stay coherent. The demo retrieves for a sample prompt and lists the template ids and titles returned.

title: Viral Generator Framework — Generation Core
description: Combines processed prompts with retrieved material into concepts.
body: The Signature edition record for the framework component: Generation Core. Combines processed prompts with retrieved material into concepts. The generation core takes the processed prompt and the retrieved templates and assembles a concept: a title built from the top template and the user's keywords, a hook phrased as a question, a sequence of beats drawn from the templates, and a call to action inviting remixing. Generation is pure and deterministic: no network, no model call, no randomness beyond the seed. The demo generates a concept from a sample prompt and returns its title, kind, hook, beat count, and call to action.

title: Viral Generator Framework — Renderer
description: Renders concepts to markdown, HTML, and plain text.
body: The Signature edition record for the framework component: Renderer. Renders concepts to markdown, HTML, and plain text. The renderer converts a concept into shareable text in three formats. Markdown gives a headed document with bold hook and numbered beats. HTML gives a self-contained article element. Plain text gives a clean share-card body. Rendering is total: every concept renders in every format with no failures, and the output is plain human-readable text. The demo renders a sample concept to markdown and reports the length and a preview.

title: Viral Generator Framework — Output Validator
description: Schema and quality checks on generated concepts.
body: The Signature edition record for the framework component: Output Validator. Schema and quality checks on generated concepts. The output validator checks every generated concept before it ships: title, kind, hook, beats, and call to action must be present; beats must number at least two; titles stay within length. It returns an honest verdict with an error list, never a silent pass. The demo validates one good and one bad concept and reports both verdicts, proving the checker catches real defects.

title: Viral Generator Framework — Personalizer
description: Applies runtime-supplied style and audience preferences; stores nothing.
body: The Signature edition record for the framework component: Personalizer. Applies runtime-supplied style and audience preferences; stores nothing. The personalizer applies style and audience preferences to a concept: epic rephrases the hook, cozy softens the call to action, and any style is recorded on the record. Preferences arrive at runtime from the user and are never stored: the personalized record carries the preferences used, not the person. The demo personalizes a sample concept with epic style for a friends audience and returns the result.

title: Viral Generator Framework — Exporter
description: Packages concepts as JSON, markdown, HTML, or share-card text with attribution.
body: The Signature edition record for the framework component: Exporter. Packages concepts as JSON, markdown, HTML, or share-card text with attribution. The exporter packages a concept for the world: JSON for machines, markdown for documents, HTML for pages, and plain-text share cards for social platforms. Every package includes an attribution line naming the framework, because viral spread without credit is a bug. The demo exports a sample concept as a share card and reports the format, filename, byte size, and attribution.
